tour_title: A Privately Arranged Family Journey from Hanoi to Ho Chi Minh City
lede: A privately arranged family journey following a graceful north-to-south rhythm through Vietnam. Combining historic Hanoi, the limestone landscapes of Ninh Binh, an overnight cruise in Ha Long Bay, the mountain air of Sapa, the beaches and heritage towns of Central Vietnam, and a meaningful final chapter in Ho Chi Minh City.
travel_style: Early check-in in Hanoi included. Private guide and driver, premium overnight train cabin.
route_txt: Hanoi – Ninh Binh – Hanoi – Halong Bay – Hanoi – Sapa – Da Nang – Hoi An – Ho Chi Minh City
overview_h2: Prepared for: Family Vacation (2 Pax) — A Privately Arranged Family Journey from Hanoi to Ho Chi Minh City
overview_p:
A privately arranged family journey following a graceful north-to-south rhythm through Vietnam. Combining historic Hanoi, the limestone landscapes of Ninh Binh, an overnight cruise in Ha Long Bay, the mountain air of Sapa, the beaches and heritage towns of Central Vietnam, and a meaningful final chapter in Ho Chi Minh City.

The programme is designed with a gentle but engaging pace. Each destination is given a clear purpose: Hanoi for history and atmosphere, Ninh Binh for rural scenery, Ha Long Bay for time on the water, Sapa for soft mountain discovery, Da Nang and Hoi An for coastal heritage, and Saigon for modern city life and wartime memory.

itinerary.summary:
Upon arrival in Hanoi, meet your private airport representative and transfer smoothly to Pullman Hanoi, where early check-in will be booked in advance. This is especially important because the majority of flights from Belgium arrive in the morning, allowing the family to rest, shower and refresh immediately after the long journey instead of waiting until the standard afternoon check-in time.

After settling in, the day remains intentionally light. Lunch is included, followed by free time to adjust to the local rhythm, enjoy the hotel facilities or take a gentle independent walk nearby if energy allows. In the evening, gather for a welcome dinner designed as a calm introduction to Vietnam, giving the family time to ease into the journey before the countryside escape begins tomorrow.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Private airport welcome, early check-in, lunch, welcome dinner, private airport transfer.

itinerary.summary:
After breakfast, leave Hanoi by private vehicle and travel south toward Ninh Binh, where limestone peaks, rice fields and village lanes create a softer countryside atmosphere. The drive takes approximately two hours, making this a comfortable transition from the capital into one of northern Vietnam’s most scenic rural regions.

Upon arrival, check in at An's Eco Garden Resort and enjoy time to settle into the garden surroundings. The Deluxe Garden View Double room provides a peaceful base for the night, with warm interiors and a relaxed countryside setting. The afternoon can remain flexible, allowing time for rest, a short walk, a riverside coffee or a gentle sunset viewpoint depending on arrival timing and energy.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Private AC transfer, resort check-in, lunch, Deluxe Garden View Double room.

itinerary.summary:
Begin the day with a gentle countryside programme in Ninh Binh, moving at a comfortable family pace. Depending on weather and local conditions, enjoy easy cycling through village lanes and rice-field scenery, with time to observe rural life, limestone backdrops and the quieter rhythm that makes this region feel so different from Hanoi.

The highlight of the day is a scenic boat journey through Trang An, where small sampans glide between karst cliffs, caves and calm waterways. Lunch is included at a selected local restaurant before returning to Hanoi in the afternoon. Back in the capital, the evening is left open for rest, a light walk or independent dining, keeping the day active but not overpacked.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Bicycle rental, Trang An boat tour tickets, private transport, lunch.

itinerary.summary:
After breakfast, travel privately from Hanoi to Ha Long Bay for the overnight cruise experience. Upon arrival at the marina, complete check-in procedures and board La Casta Cruise, where the day transitions from road travel to a slower rhythm on the water among limestone islands and open bay scenery.

Lunch is served onboard as the cruise begins its journey through Ha Long and Lan Ha Bay landscapes. In the afternoon, activities may include kayaking, a bamboo boat ride, swimming or a cave visit, subject to the cruise route and weather conditions. The Junior Suite with sea-view balcony provides a comfortable private space for the overnight stay, allowing guests to enjoy bay views even during quiet moments between scheduled cruise activities.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Private transfer to bay, cruise tickets, onboard activities, lunch, dinner.

itinerary.summary:
Wake to the calm morning atmosphere of the bay, when the limestone formations are often softened by mist and early light. The cruise programme may include a short morning activity, tai chi on deck or a final scenic passage, depending on the confirmed route, operating conditions and weather on the day.

After breakfast or brunch onboard, disembark and meet your private driver for the return journey to Hanoi. The afternoon and evening are kept relaxed so the family can rest after the cruise, repack for the mountain section and enjoy Hanoi at a slower pace. This pause is important before the following day’s city discovery and overnight train to Sapa.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Onboard breakfast/brunch, private return transfer to Hanoi.

itinerary.summary:
After breakfast, begin a privately guided Hanoi discovery focused on history, local atmosphere and family-friendly pacing. Visit Hoa Lo Prison Relic, a powerful but well-presented site that introduces an important chapter of Vietnam’s modern history. Continue with time around the Old Quarter, local streets and selected cafe stops, with the route adjusted according to traffic and walking comfort.

Lunch is included during the day. In the afternoon, visit the Train Street coffee area where viewing is subject to local safety rules and permitted access points. Later, return to the hotel to refresh and prepare for the rail journey. In the evening, transfer privately to Hanoi railway station and board the Chapa Express overnight train to Lao Cai, staying in a comfortable cabin for the journey toward Sapa.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Hanoi city tour guide, entries, private transfers, Chapa Express sleeper ticket.

itinerary.summary:
Arrive early in Lao Cai and continue by private transfer up to Sapa, where cooler air, mountain views and terraced valleys mark a clear change in landscape. After time to freshen up, begin a soft trekking programme designed around comfort rather than intensity, allowing the family to enjoy scenery and local culture without a demanding pace.

The route may include gentle village paths, viewpoints and conversations about ethnic community life in the highlands. Lunch is included during the programme. In the afternoon, check in at Silk Path Sapa and enjoy leisure time to rest, use the hotel facilities, visit a cafe or simply take in the mountain setting. The evening is left free for personal dining and recovery after the overnight train.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Private transfer Lao Cai to Sapa, trekking guide, lunch, Silk Path Sapa check-in.

itinerary.summary:
Enjoy a slower morning in Sapa before departing by private transfer toward the airport for the flight to Da Nang. The timing of this day will depend on the confirmed domestic flight schedule, so the programme is intentionally arranged with flexibility to protect comfort and avoid unnecessary pressure during the long transition from mountains to coast.

Upon arrival in Da Nang, meet your private guide and driver for the transfer to Radisson RED Danang. The hotel provides a modern beachfront base for the central Vietnam section of the journey, with easy access to the beach, city dining and the next day’s sightseeing route. The evening is free to rest after travel, enjoy the sea air or explore nearby areas independently.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Private airport transfer, flight Sapa-Da Nang, arrival transfer, Radisson RED Danang check-in.

itinerary.summary:
After breakfast, begin a privately guided day combining Da Nang’s coastal landmarks with Hoi An’s heritage atmosphere. Visit Marble Mountains, where caves, pagodas and viewpoints reveal one of the city’s most recognisable natural sites. The visit can be adjusted with elevators and gentle routing to keep the pace comfortable.

Continue toward Cam Thanh Coconut Forest for a light basket boat experience among water coconut palms, followed by lunch at a selected local restaurant. In the late afternoon and evening, explore Hoi An Ancient Town, known for lantern-lit streets, old merchant houses, the riverfront and small craft shops. Return to Da Nang after the programme, keeping the overnight base unchanged for convenience.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Guide, Marble Mountain entry, basket boat ticket, Hoi An walking tour.

itinerary.summary:
Today moves beyond the most familiar coastal route to introduce Central Vietnam’s layered history and quieter heritage sites. Depending on confirmed routing, visit selected Cham tower remains or cultural stops that reflect the region’s ancient Champa legacy, adding a historical dimension to the beach and old-town experiences of previous days.

Continue to Ky Anh Tunnel, where local wartime stories are presented through a smaller and less commercial setting than many major historical attractions. The experience gives context to village resilience, hidden shelter systems and community memory in Quang Nam. Lunch is included during the day, and the route will be managed carefully to balance travel time, outdoor exposure and family comfort before returning to Da Nang.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Cham towers entry, Ky Anh tunnel tour, guide, transport, lunch.

itinerary.summary:
After breakfast, check out from Da Nang and transfer privately toward Hoi An for a relaxed countryside and local-life programme. Begin with gentle cycling or a soft countryside visit through flat village lanes, rice fields and small farms, with stops adapted to the family’s comfort level and interest in local daily life.

Lunch is included at a selected home-style or local restaurant in the Hoi An area. In the afternoon, the programme can continue with Tra Que Vegetable Village, riverside scenery, light shopping or cafe time in the Ancient Town. Later, transfer to Hoiana for check-in and a more resort-style evening by the coast, creating a refined pause before the journey continues south to Ho Chi Minh City.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Bicycle rental, Tra Que entry, resort transfer, Hoiana Resort check-in.

itinerary.summary:
After breakfast, transfer from Hoiana to Da Nang Airport for the domestic flight to Ho Chi Minh City. Upon arrival, meet your private driver and continue to Liberty Central Saigon Riverside Hotel for check-in. The afternoon is kept flexible for rest, unpacking or a short independent walk along the riverfront.

In the evening, enjoy a Saigon by Night tour with dinner included. The experience introduces the city’s modern river skyline, illuminated streets, lively neighbourhood energy and local dining atmosphere. Depending on the confirmed routing and traffic, the tour may include the Ba Son Bridge area, Nguyen Hue Boulevard, the riverfront and selected photo stops, giving the family a vibrant first impression of southern Vietnam after dark.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Airport transfers, flight Da Nang-Saigon, Saigon by Night tour with dinner.

itinerary.summary:
Depart Ho Chi Minh City after breakfast for a privately guided excursion to the Cu Chi Tunnels, one of the most important wartime sites in southern Vietnam. With your guide, explore selected tunnel sections, reconstructed living areas, hidden entrances and interpretive displays that explain how underground networks supported communication, shelter and survival during the war.

The special highlight of the day is an exclusive meeting with Mr. To Van Duc, subject to his health and final availability. Through first-hand memories and personal storytelling, this encounter adds a human dimension that typical sightseeing cannot provide. Lunch is included during the excursion. Return to Ho Chi Minh City in the afternoon, with the evening left free for rest or independent exploration.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Cu Chi Tunnels entry, guide, transport, lunch.

itinerary.summary:
Enjoy the final morning in Ho Chi Minh City at a relaxed pace. Depending on the confirmed flight schedule, there may be time for a short walk near the hotel, last-minute shopping, coffee by the river or simply a calm breakfast before preparing for the airport transfer.

Lunch is included subject to the departure timing. Your private driver will transfer the family to Tan Son Nhat International Airport for the outbound flight, concluding a journey that has moved from Hanoi’s history to Ninh Binh’s landscapes, Ha Long Bay’s water scenery, Sapa’s mountains, Central Vietnam’s heritage and a meaningful Saigon finale.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Private airport departure transfer, lunch (depending on flight timing).
